meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

You have about twenty minutes, Hale, and I have a client call at 4:40. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero is based on.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
And did you show Owen any of this before you entered the zero, Hale, because procedure 4.1 says you speak with the student first?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
You still haven't answered me on 4.1, Hale. A seventeen-year-old getting a quotation wrong is a marking error, not proof of anything. I'm writing down the act you gave me, and I'll check it myself.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

That's 4.4, and I want it in an email tonight, with the line about nothing on his record word for word. Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the vice-principal and no other students, is that what you're promising? Before I agree to anything, who else has seen this so far?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you acknowledged that you entered Owen's zero before contacting me, and you proposed a supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require those terms in writing, confirmation that no other students will be present, and answers on who else has seen this matter and whether Owen was spoken to before the mark was entered. I expect that email tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her fallback position, since your offer under procedure 4.4 met her demand that nothing goes on his record, but she had not yet accepted the rewrite and still wants it in writing, still wants no other students present, and still wants to know who else has seen this; that is close to the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You laid out the 4.4 reassessment with exact terms, a time, a place and a supervisor, which met her one non-negotiable on paper.
What cost ground: You never answered her question about whether Owen was shown the evidence before the zero went in, which kept her fighting on procedure instead of weighing your evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history placed the essay's writing late on the night before it was due, right on that kind of night, which is why she went short and switched to procedure; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether you spoke with Owen before entering the zero, answer that directly, even if the answer is no, before you move on to the misquoted line.
